title: Microsoft Resolves Remote Desktop Bugs From Windows Updates
excerpt: Microsoft fixes a bug that blocked non-admin users from using Remote Desktop when the Administrator protection security feature was active.
body_html:
Microsoft has addressed a known bug that affected Remote Desktop connections for non-administrator users. The issue occurred when the Administrator protection security feature was enabled on devices following recent Windows updates.

With the fix now implemented, standard users should be able to connect properly without encountering the previous connection block tied to the security setting.
